text: 1. Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China, and be in good health.2. Must come from jointly build the Belt and Road countries3. The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must:- be a high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs;- be a bachelor’s degree holder and no more than 35 when applying for the master’s programs;- be a master’s degree holder and no more than 40 when applying for the doctoral programs.4. Language requirements:Applicants to the Chinese Teaching undergraduate program are only eligible to apply if their Chinese language proficiency is at least HSK3; applicants to postgraduate program are only eligible to apply if their Chinese language proficiency is at least HSK4. Applicants to the English Teaching program are required to provide proof of English language proficiency.5. Applicants should fulfill the admission requirements for both academic ability, language ability and other aspects required by the university.
